UI fixes: the mock-up

Your call: reply in chat with Approve, Change (say what) or Rethink. Approve leads to the final plan page; nothing is built before you approve that.

These are screenshots of the real app on real test parts from tests/parts. The new behaviour of the model (one feature lit, the rest grey; the machine view's camera) comes from a throwaway prototype that will not be kept. The new buttons, the examples list, the Part / Machine switch and the labels are drawn into the page for the picture. Tap a picture to zoom.

Checks you can try on the work copy

  • Pick Deep hole ×2 on report_sample: one hole lit, the rest grey; › lights the other.
  • Spin the part with the wheel and by dragging: no pins while it moves, pins back within a quarter second of stopping. I will also time a big part on a production build before and after and give you the numbers.
  • Middle-drag moves, Shift + middle-drag rotates, the wheel zooms to the mouse, in Chrome or Edge at work; no autoscroll circle.
  • Tab to the model: arrows rotate, + − zoom, H goes home.
  • Open… with a STEP and its .ipt picked together; Examples ▾ loads each of the four.
  • Machining, Machine: each setup chip puts the spindle on top; tapping a tool lights its faces.
